limitations: The compiler ran without project dependencies and reported 1,047 errors. Only successfully bound direct fields are scored; unresolved or other field uses are not a negative denominator.

All 265 bound direct-field sites and all 265 selected stored own-field references agree at method, target and token bytes. This is selected known-Java evidence, not complete source recall or independent held-out quality.
No foreign-field access, WMC, TCC, ATFD, god-object classifier, runtime-path or Graphify comparison is established.

An initial compiler capture used a 1,000-error reporting cap and preserved identical candidate bindings. The corrected capture raised that cap to the registered 10,000 diagnostic bound and retained all 1,047 errors.
The compiler diagnostics reflect an intentionally empty external classpath; these selected bindings cannot establish recall for unresolved or foreign fields.
scope: Compiler-bound direct own-field accesses in eight known rated Java classes; partial attribution with absent project dependencies.
